🚀 COSMIC MINDS | SLIIT – NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

We are a passionate team of SLIIT undergraduates driven by technology, innovation, and space exploration. Our interests include AI/ML, Data Science, Software Engineering, Web Development, and creative problem-solving.

We welcome enthusiastic members skilled in Python, AI/ML, Data Analytics, Web Development, UI/UX, GIS, Astronomy, and Research.

Passion, creativity, teamwork, and curiosity matter most!
